extDescription.message: Connects the WebMCP tools of one chosen tab (Haven and other allowed sites) to MCP clients such as Goose or Claude Code.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions.

connecting.description: Popup status while connecting to the local bridge daemon.

toolsSourceHeading.message: Tools for MCP clients come from
toolsSourceHeading.description: Popup heading above the choice of tab whose tools MCP clients get.

targetsAria.description: Accessible name of the tab choice.

recordPayloads.description: Checkbox: keep tool call arguments and responses in the debug log.

debugGui.description: Button that opens the debug GUI in a tab.

allowedSites.description: Heading of the list of web origins the extension may connect.

originInputAria.description: Accessible name of the input for a new origin.

allow.description: Button that adds the typed origin to the allowed sites.

statusConnected.message: Connected to the bridge on port $PORT$ · $CLIENTS$
statusConnected.description: Popup status. port: TCP port number; clients: text from clientsCount.

statusNotRunning.message: Bridge not running. Start your MCP client, or run: haven-agent-bridge daemon
statusNotRunning.description: Popup status when no local daemon answers. Keep the command as is.

choiceActiveTitle.message: The allowed tab I used last
choiceActiveTitle.description: Tab choice: always use the allowed tab the user activated last.

choiceActiveNow.description: Subtitle: which tab that currently is.

choiceActiveFollows.description: Subtitle when the choice is not the current default.

choiceOriginTitle.description: Tab choice: any tab of one origin.

choiceOriginSub.description: Subtitle of the origin choice: the tab of that origin used last.

choiceConnected.description: Marker after the tab that MCP clients are using right now.

polyfill.description: Marker for tabs whose WebMCP comes from the extension's polyfill instead of Chrome.

noAllowedTab.description: Empty state of the tab choice.

reload.description: Link button that reloads a tab that has not connected yet.

notConnectedYet.description: A tab opened before the extension was installed; title: tab title.

remove.description: Link button that removes an allowed origin.

removeOriginAria.description: Accessible name of the remove button.

saveFailed.description: Error when the allowed origins could not be stored.

invalidOrigin.message: Enter a URL like https://example.com or http://localhost:5173
invalidOrigin.description: Error for an input that is not a URL. Keep the example URLs.

onlyHttp.message: Only http and https sites are supported.

permissionDenied.message: Chrome did not grant access to that site.
permissionDenied.description: Error when Chrome's permission prompt was declined.

badgeTools.description: Toolbar button tooltip. tools: text from toolsCount; origin: web origin.

badgeNoTab.message: Haven Agent Bridge: no tab selected
badgeNoTab.description: Toolbar button tooltip when no tab is selected.

badgeNotRunning.message: Haven Agent Bridge: bridge not running
badgeNotRunning.description: Toolbar button tooltip when the local daemon is not running.

clientsCount_one.description: Number of connected MCP clients (Goose, Claude Code, …).

clientsCount_other.description: Number of connected MCP clients (Goose, Claude Code, …).

toolsCount_one.description: Number of WebMCP tools a tab offers.

toolsCount_other.description: Number of WebMCP tools a tab offers.
